scope: Authored proposals only; no shared topic/deep-dive bank edited.

comparison.position: 检索模型并实际验证合并，再以消融定位高影响代码块，内层改写/验证、外层重新定位，集成另行搜索。
comparison.tradeoff: 搜索材料与块级训练反馈必须真实执行；不同于MARS按成本奖励调度仓库候选。八V100及小时级完整矩阵不复现，本地无控制器或能力指标。

analysis.title: 寻找值得改的部件，与决定把预算花在哪个分支，是不同控制问题
analysis.body: MLE-STAR用执行消融选择代码块，在相对固定的局部空间内反复提出计划；MARS则通过预算感知MCTS安排模块化候选，并把新旧代码与运行差异变成跨分支经验。局部影响与性能/时间折中可以互补，却不是同一个分数；高耗时竞赛上的原文结果也不能拿来给本地空控制器背书。两者收录都应明确生成脚本、完整编排器与已运行能力三种不同资产。

question.question: 一处修改影响很大但训练昂贵，MLE-STAR的消融定位与MARS的预算奖励会作同一个决定吗？
question.answer: 不一定。消融回答哪个部件值得深入，预算奖励还按性能与执行时间取舍候选。前者不自动包含MARS的时间惩罚，后者也不自动实现MLE-STAR的块内计划搜索；应分别固定真实validation和运行成本再组合。
question.example: 教学例：缺失值处理每次提高0.01却需一小时，另一路提高0.008只要一分钟。影响排序与预算内的探索价值可以不同，不能只看一列精度。

update.summary: 补入检索初始化与消融定向细化，区分块级搜索与成本感知树调度；核对2025精确v1日期、生成产物与控制器源码边界，完整实验高成本不复现。

comparison.position: Retrieve models, validate beneficial merges, then target influential blocks with ablations and nested plan/evaluation loops; search ensembles separately.
comparison.tradeoff: Real training and ablations are required. This is not MARS's cost-aware repository scheduling. The eight-V100, multi-hour full matrix is deferred; no local controller or capability metrics are supplied.

analysis.title: Targeting an influential component differs from allocating budget across branches
analysis.body: MLE-STAR uses executed ablations to focus local plans on a block. MARS schedules modular candidates with budget-aware MCTS and converts code/result differences into transferable lessons. Local impact and performance/time tradeoffs can complement each other but are not one score. Neither paper's competition results validate an empty local controller. Generated scripts, orchestration source, and executed capability are distinct assets.

question.question: Would MLE-STAR's ablation targeting and MARS's budget reward always choose the same expensive but influential change?
question.answer: No. Ablation asks where refinement matters; a budget reward also trades performance against execution time. Neither automatically implements the other's search rule. A combination must separately fix validation and measured cost.
question.example: Teaching example: a preprocessing change gains 0.01 in one hour, while another branch gains 0.008 in one minute. Influence and budget-limited exploration value can differ.

english.update: Add retrieval initialization and ablation-targeted refinement; distinguish local block search from cost-aware tree scheduling. Pin the exact2025v1 date and separate generated artifacts from controller source; full experiments are cost-deferred.

comparison.position: 固定人类评价合同，混合LLM提案、级联执行评价与多维进化档案，异步探索程序空间。
comparison.tradeoff: 指标优化仍受评价器充分性约束，不等于ScientistOne的主张/引用/方法完整性审计。官方只开放构造验证资料，完整搜索/生产矩阵高成本不复现，本地没有算子。

analysis.title: 发现更好的对象，与证明对它的研究主张有证据，是不同验收层
analysis.body: AlphaEvolve需要一个能实际评价候选程序的目标，靠程序库和模型提案产生改进；ScientistOne继续追问论文数字是否复算、引文是否存在并支持主张、方法文字是否对应代码。构造通过指定检查只支持那项性质，不能把生成的论文全部自动判真；证据链可靠也不能保证搜索有创新。官方结果notebook可验证已给出的对象，但不恢复原发现过程，本库因此只收录有据成本审查。

question.question: 一个已发表矩阵构造通过验证，为何仍不能说本地AlphaEvolve和科研完整性都已验证？
question.answer: 构造检查没有执行提案、进化档案和分布式搜索，所以不验证发现能力；它也不检查论文所有数值、引用或方法描述，所以不替代CoE审计。每项证据只支持它实际检查的对象。
question.example: 教学例：rank-48复数构造通过验证，却不能支持“任意域rank-48”或“本地重新发现”两个更强主张；后两者需要各自额外证据。

update.summary: 补入经典程序进化与评价级联，区分搜索结果、构造验证与研究主张完整性；记录官方未发布运行系统、完整实验高成本不复现和零本地执行能力。

comparison.position: Fix a human evaluation contract and explore programs using mixed-model proposals, executed cascades, multidimensional archives, and asynchronous workers.
comparison.tradeoff: Optimization depends on evaluator sufficiency and does not provide ScientistOne's claim/citation/method audit. Official artifacts verify constructions, not the controller; full search/production matrices are deferred with no local operator.

analysis.title: Discovering a better object differs from grounding research claims about it
analysis.body: AlphaEvolve searches using task-specific executable feedback. ScientistOne additionally checks numerical recomputation, citation support, and method/code alignment. A construction verifier establishes only its checked property, not every claim in a generated paper; a reliable evidence chain also does not guarantee novelty. Official result notebooks cannot recover the original discovery process, so the local contribution remains a cost-reviewed reference.

question.question: Why does verifying a published matrix construction establish neither local AlphaEvolve discovery nor complete research integrity?
question.answer: It does not execute proposals, archives, or distributed search, and it does not audit all numbers, citations, or prose/code alignment. Evidence supports only the object and property actually checked.
question.example: Teaching example: a valid complex rank-48 construction does not establish rank48 over every field or local rediscovery. Each stronger claim needs separate evidence.

english.update: Add classical program evolution and cascaded evaluation; distinguish search results, construction verification, and claim grounding. The full runtime is not released or locally executed, and full experiments are cost-deferred.
